title: A proper zero-dimensional scheme over a field is finite
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $Y$ be a scheme proper over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism] with $\dim Y\le0$ [def-pc-dimension]. Then the structure morphism $Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], $Y$ is affine [def-pc-scheme], and $\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ is finite-dimensional as a $k$-vector space.
